$comment: Maps a Still release version to the work it carries, so a reader can tell which
build contains which journey. The published artifact is the GitHub tag archive
of Jongtae/Still, consumed by scripts/install.sh and by this repository's own
Formula/agentos.rb. No Still release is published yet; v0.1.0 is the first.
Releases v1.0.4-v1.4.1 belong to the private predecessor Jongtae/agentos and
they are not Still releases. See docs/release.en.md.

unpublished.why_no_commit: The future tagged main merge commit does not exist; no earlier source SHA can stand in for it.
unpublished.why_no_checksum: No v0.1.0 GitHub tag archive exists; its served SHA-256 must be measured only after publication.
unpublished.carries: First Still release, restarted at 0.1.0 from the predecessor's in-tree 1.4.2; milestone v0.1.0 (#4, #45, #46, #48, #51). It carries the predecessor source imported on 2026-10-17 and the repository transition: public entry points, installer and development references point at Jongtae/Still, the Homebrew formula lives in this repository (brew tap jongtae/still https://github.com/Jongtae/Still), and the agentos command, data directory and AGENTOS_* variables are kept for compatibility. It also carries the fixes merged before preparation: WebKit process start before the first navigation deadline (#5), closing a disconnected web client without replaying (#6), the procedure-library replacement message (#7), a pinned turn clock in Work regression tests (#9), recovered steps told apart from unresolved failures (#14), and the PR-body reuse review guide (#59).
unpublished.not_claimed: No install of this tag archive was observed before publication; the publish workflow's macOS brew install/brew test and the installer smoke run only after the tag exists, and the owner's own upgrade is not yet recorded. Installs from the predecessor's Jongtae/homebrew-agentos tap are not moved to this tap by this release. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations, model-dependent behavior or a background service surviving a restart.
